title: Choose the visual world for Emmanuel's portfolio
question: The roll assigned Demo Control Room. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. (Client demo sites stay exactly as approved in every option — this only governs the portfolio's own pages.)

options.label: Demo Control Room
options.lineage: Live-broadcast production galleries: program/preview monitors, tally lights, the run sheet
options.thesis: The portfolio is the gallery where the demo goes live: real builds on the monitor wall, honest tally status on every source.
materials: lit monitor glass showing real captures
options.viewport: Left: name, role, one-line value prop, Resume / View Work / Contact. Right: a multiview wall — VYBE on the large PROGRAM monitor, Cactus revenue system and Palmer on preview monitors, each with a source label and tally (LIVE / DEMO DATA / NOT ACTIVATED).
options.risk: Could read as a fake dashboard if any monitor shows anything other than a real, clickable build.

raised.raise: The Solution Lab is a semantic status board: each client build is a row whose tally restyles it without breaking the grid.
Case studies run as a strict linear run sheet — Problem → Discovery → Architecture → Demo → Tradeoffs → Handoff — with a visible current-step state.
One signal color, tally red, is reserved for LIVE only; everything else is graphite and paper.
Motion comes from the medium: hard cuts and dissolves between sources, never floaty easing.
Rack focus between program and preview monitors as the hero's scroll interaction.

options.label: Statement of Work
options.thesis: Every case study is set as the proposal Emmanuel would hand a buyer: scope, assumptions, architecture, out-of-scope, sign-off.
options.viewport: A cover sheet: name, role, 'Prepared for: hiring teams', with the live-build index as the table of contents beside it.
options.risk: Familiar document-editorial territory; paper-and-serif renditions are where many runs land.

options.label: Split-Flap Concourse
options.thesis: Every build is a departure: destination, platform, status — cascading when it changes.
options.viewport: A full-width board of builds — VYBE, Cactus, Palmer, Canham — with status and 'Open' columns.
options.case: Holds product clarity (status rows map to live/demo/inactive) but recruiters don't identify presales with rail boards.
options.risk: Novelty wears off after the first cascade; case-study depth is hard to carry.

options.label: Shareware Installer
options.thesis: The career as an install sequence.
options.case: Gated steps block recruiters; reads as a gag.
options.kept: Strict linear sequence with visible step state.

options.label: Calavera Broadside
options.kept: Single-ink restraint with one alarm color.

options.label: Ebru Marbling
options.kept: Motion made by the medium itself.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The polished tech-consultant portfolio, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Name + role left, stacked project screenshots right.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other portfolios by design.
